status: Private execution contract recorded before evaluation; no live/provider/public/product/owner admission
composition: A separate injected-reader native renderer probe prepares one mixed namespace/storage publication using the existing InventorySession. Start/release/poll and actual retirement are explicit and finite before renderer entry. Retain its readonly port and cached FrontendSession; destroy the inventory session before rendering. The frozen publication and its complete native frame/reference owners remain available through renderer teardown.
invocation: Private probe only: __disked_nt_inventory_renderer_fixture followed by gui, tui or shell, one explicitly generated fixture-JSON path and one explicit new receipt-JSON path. Receipt creation refuses existing output without truncation; valid renderer output goes only to that owned receipt. Accept only ordinary absolute drive paths ending in .json, without extra colons, namespace/UNC prefixes or reserved device basenames. Read at most 1048576 bytes with the existing bounded private JSON profile. Reject other argument shapes/modes or malformed launcher shapes before creating output or starting readers. Malformed binary/query responses remain controlled reader fixtures. Existing injected namespace/metadata/identity child roles remain exact. No public DiskEd flags, product composition changes, live paths, physical devices or elevation.

launcher_rejection.argument_shape_or_mode: Exit 2, no stdout/stderr, no reader or receipt creation.
launcher_rejection.path: Exit 3, refused/fixture_path, reader_starts and controller namespace/storage API counts zero. Both input and receipt reject relative, UNC/namespace, extra-colon, non-json, wildcard/control, dot/parent, trailing-space/dot and reserved-device components (including numbered superscripts).
launcher_rejection.launcher_shape: Exit 3 before receipt/readers: missing or incorrectly typed fields give fixture_shape; unknown composition gives fixture_composition; empty/non-array/over-three stages or non-object source give fixture_stages; incorrect registry collection types give fixture_registry.
launcher_rejection.bounded_json: Exit 3 before receipt/readers: invalid_json, duplicate_key, depth_limit_exceeded (35), string_limit_exceeded (32768), or fixture_input_limit (1048576 bytes), as applicable.
launcher_rejection.existing_receipt: Exit 3 refused/fixture_receipt_unavailable before readers; CREATE_NEW preserves the existing file bytes, including when the receipt aliases the fixture input.
launcher_rejection.diagnostic: Refusal stdout is one JSON object with status, reason, reader_starts, namespace_api_calls and storage_api_calls. Stderr remains empty for these bounded launcher rejections. These are private probe outcomes, not public DiskEd exit/API contracts.

presentation: Use existing Windows GUI and console renderers with common cached-observation models. Cached GUI title is DiskEd - Cached observation prototype and summary starts Current: cached observations | Proposed: none. Linear cached shell heading is DiskEd shell | CACHED OBSERVATIONS | linear. Existing Fake titles/headers/summary, native window class, commands, focus rules and product defaults remain unchanged. Existing cached TUI/shell model headers remain authoritative. Profile selection is compiled composition state, never inferred from untrusted metadata.
inspection: Native GUI controls and hidden-console screen/linear text preserve inert complete original cached data, exact observation focus and manual cached refresh. target.inspect returns the exact retained node and binding; health.assess refuses observation_not_storage_target without calling a health/storage port. Original names, identifiers, control sequences and UTF16 code units remain data. Cached callbacks perform no start/poll/wait/retire/native API or allocating rebuild. No automatic source advancement in CompletionPoll or renderer tick.
evidence: On renderer exit retain actual native source worker receipts, original frames and advertised complete identity reference values, generic graph/snapshot ownership, available model state and final shared frontend selection, callback/controller API counts, actual renderer exit and frozen publication retrieval after source-session destruction. Host helpers retain actual final control/console observations before closing the owned renderer. Keep exact source/registry/fixture/executable identities and host desktop/console observations. A GUI or terminal failure remains a failed/unavailable check rather than fabricated qualification.
limits: Existing source, query, frame, node/graph, display, worker/job and 256-MiB frontend process budgets remain. The fixture launcher may bound its selected scenarios more narrowly; it must not widen production limits or truncate complete evidence. No publication history chain, concurrent access, public resolver or storage authority.
